title: P4 prospective validation: prompting-strategy ranking on a fresh 30-seed collection
data: New collection (deepseek-v4-flash, 30 independent seeds x 3 prompting strategies x 5 GSM8K-style problems per seed); no P4-archived data used
decision_function_Q: prompting-strategy ranking by solve accuracy (chain-of-thought / direct / structured-verify)
criteria: ii: corrected CI of the flip contrast excludes [-delta, delta]
iv: flip reproduces in >= 80% of R1 subsamples
